# Tester Swarm

> Reciprocal closed-testing marketplace for Google Play (12 testers × 14 continuous days) with SDK-verified install and foreground usage.

## Documentation
- [Android Kotlin SDK Guide](https://testerswarm.dev/docs/sdk/android): Zero-code integration (1 dependency + 1 manifest meta-data).
- [Flutter Plugin Guide](https://testerswarm.dev/docs/sdk/flutter): Android-only Flutter wrapper (`flutter pub add testerswarm`).
- [React Native Wrapper Guide](https://testerswarm.dev/docs/sdk/react-native): Android-only React Native / Expo Dev Client wrapper (`npm install @testerswarm/react-native`).
- [Full LLM Install Guide](https://testerswarm.dev/llms-full.txt): Single-file deterministic instructions for AI coding assistants.

## Guides
- [12 Testers for 14 Days Google Play Requirement](https://testerswarm.dev/guides/12-testers-14-days-google-play)
- [Closed Testing Step by Step](https://testerswarm.dev/guides/closed-testing-step-by-step)
- [Production Access Questionnaire Guide](https://testerswarm.dev/guides/production-access-questionnaire)

## Community
- [r/AndroidAppTesters](https://www.reddit.com/r/AndroidAppTesters): Community support for Android closed testing.
